verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no built-in Bland AI that generates or improves prompts, pathways, or test cases from a description. The closest items fall outside the story: the MCP server lets external AI coding agents build pathways (the user's own AI, not the platform's), the testbed only supports manual prompt editing and re-running, and Evals use LLM judges to grade calls rather than author agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's own AI helps me author agents — generating or improving prompts, flows, and test cases from a description
